groups.google_auth_description: Create an OAuth client of type Web application in Google Cloud, enter its Client ID and Client Secret below, then enable Google sign-in. Email sign-in can stay enabled. Save these settings separately in each environment.
groups.r2_description: Store input images and generated videos in Cloudflare R2. Configure S3 credentials, the bucket and its public domain.
groups.polaris_description: Configure any Wan-compatible API key, endpoint and model IDs. Separate OpenRouter, Replicate, Fal, Gemini and Kie settings remain available below; their protocols are not interchangeable.

secrets.clear_tip: Turn this on and save changes to remove the stored value.

google_auth_enabled.title: Enable Google sign-in
google_auth_enabled.tip: The Google button appears on sign-in and sign-up pages only when this is enabled and both credentials are present. Turning this off does not disable email sign-in.

google_one_tap_enabled.title: Enable Google One Tap (optional)
google_one_tap_enabled.tip: Not required for standard Google sign-in. For One Tap, also register the matching JavaScript origin in Google Cloud: http://localhost:3000 or https://wanai30.com.

google_client_id.title: Google Client ID
google_client_id.tip: Use an OAuth Web client ID, not a Gemini API key. Register these exact authorized redirect URIs in Google Cloud: local http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/google; production https://wanai30.com/api/auth/callback/google. Do not append /zh or a trailing slash.

google_client_secret.title: Google Client Secret
google_client_secret.tip: Use the secret paired with this Client ID. It is server-only and stored values are never sent back to the browser. Leave blank to keep the saved value; use the clear switch and save to remove it.

settings_errors.invalid_base_url: Enter a public HTTPS endpoint without credentials, query parameters or fragments.
settings_errors.invalid_api_key: The API key must not contain whitespace or a Bearer prefix.
settings_errors.invalid_model_id: One or more model IDs are invalid. Use identifiers supplied by the provider.
settings_errors.invalid_r2_settings: Check the 32-character Account ID, bucket name, S3 endpoint and upload path.
settings_errors.invalid_output_hosts: Enter exact download hostnames without a protocol, path or wildcard.
settings_errors.invalid_price: Wan prices must be whole or half credits from 1 to 99,999.5, or blank to disable.
settings_errors.invalid_settings: The settings are invalid. Check the values and save again.

check.title: Check Wan API models
check.description: Read /v1/models using the saved API key and endpoint. Model IDs can be entered manually if the provider does not support model discovery.
check.idle: No request is made until you start the check.
check.empty: The connection succeeded, but no supported Wan models were returned.
check.list_label: Wan models returned by the API

errors.unauthenticated: Your session expired. Sign in and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to check these settings.
errors.missing_key: Save a Wan API key before checking models.
errors.invalid_base_url: The saved base URL is invalid.
errors.invalid_api_key: The saved API key format is invalid.
errors.invalid_key: The provider rejected the saved API key.
errors.access_denied: The saved API key cannot list models.
errors.rate_limited: The API is rate limiting checks. Try again later.
errors.unavailable: The API is unavailable or does not support model discovery. Check the endpoint or enter model IDs manually.
errors.timeout: The API check timed out. Try again.
errors.invalid_response: The API returned an invalid response.
